principles: Rename producers and consumers of each token atomically; delete legacy-detection rather than stub it.
Sign every gate in this story via the worktree binary so the new salt is used consistently.
No-compat: do not keep koala read-fallbacks for config/storage; old data is not migrated.
Keep tsc + suite green and the residue gate PASS at every step; never touch the deferred story-4 gate self-IDs.
drivers: The salt rename invalidates in-flight signatures (user-accepted) — but THIS story's own gates must stay self-consistent via the worktree binary.
Shared main with an active concurrent host — a broken build/test would also block them.
.koala/ and config renames touch storage/config; under no-compat they are pure renames with no migration.

options.name: surgical-categorized-rename
pros: Salt stays consistent via worktree binary
Each category (salt/detection/schema/config/storage) handled with its own risk in mind
cons: Large surface (~57 files); careful enumeration needed

options.name: blanket-sed-koala-to-lattice
cons: Would rewrite the deferred KOALA_RESIDUE_* gate self-IDs and .lattice/story history

rationale: A surgical, category-aware rename keeps the salt-signing self-consistent (worktree binary), preserves the deferred story-4 gate self-IDs, and handles the config/storage renames as deliberate no-compat moves, whereas a blanket sed would corrupt the deferred gate IDs and the salt consistency.

preMortem.scenario: The salt rename self-rejects this story's own gates
preMortem.trigger: a gate signature (init-check/review/delivery) is produced by the global lattice (main old-salt dist) instead of the worktree binary
preMortem.consequence: this story's stored _hash is old-salt and the worktree DONE gate rejects it as tampered
preMortem.mitigation: run EVERY lattice gate command for this story from the worktree (node <worktree>/bin/lattice.js); rebuild worktree dist after the salt edit before signing

preMortem.scenario: A blanket replace rewrites the deferred story-4 gate self-IDs or .lattice/story history
preMortem.consequence: KOALA_RESIDUE_* renamed (breaks the gate wiring) or audit history mutated
preMortem.mitigation: exclude handlers/review-preflight.ts KOALA_RESIDUE_*, scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs, docs/, experiments/, .lattice/story; assert they are unchanged after

preMortem.scenario: Code still WRITES to .koala/ after the path rename, splitting runtime data
preMortem.trigger: a writer of .koala/activity.jsonl (or similar) is missed while readers are renamed
preMortem.consequence: telemetry/runtime data written to one path and read from another
preMortem.mitigation: grep for every .koala/ read AND write; point all to the lattice runtime dir; no .koala/ path literal remains in packages/*/src

preMortem.scenario: Renaming the idleKoala config field / koala.config.json breaks config loading
preMortem.trigger: a consumer reads the old field name or filename not updated with the producer
preMortem.consequence: the config setting silently defaults / a config file is not found
preMortem.mitigation: rename field+filename across every reader/writer together; tsc + the config/load smokes green; accept that pre-existing koala-named config is not read (no-compat)

preMortem.scenario: Deleting isKoalaSelfRepoBootstrap removes a needed self-repo guard
preMortem.trigger: the function gates a real self-repo bootstrap path, not just legacy detection
preMortem.mitigation: inspect its callers; if it is genuine self-repo logic rename it (lattice), if it is purely legacy-koala detection delete it; covered by the bootstrap smokes
